# MOY IQ Invest

> Educational tool for Spanish-speaking investors to track a portfolio, size each position with their own risk rule, and read technical indicators explained in plain Spanish. Free public beta since the relaunch on 2026-10-08. Not a broker, does not execute orders, does not give investment advice.

URL: https://invest.moyiq.app
Language: Spanish
Status: free public beta (relaunch v2, 2026-10-08). No card required, no paid plans on sale. If paid plans exist in the future, users will be notified in advance and what they use today is kept.

## What it does

- Portfolio tracking with result per position, watchlist, price alerts, dividend calendar and a trade journal. Positions are entered manually; there is no broker connection.
- Technical indicators (moving averages, RSI, MACD, volume, Bollinger bands) shown one by one, each with its value, its reference range and a plain-language reading. Example: "RSI 58 — neutral zone (30–70), neither overbought nor oversold".
- No aggregate rating: the tool does not grade assets with a single 0-100 number.
- Position-size calculator based on the user's own risk rule (max % of capital at risk per trade), with a per-position concentration limit and risk-at-stop per position and in total. Rebalancing toward target weights the user defines.
- Asset comparison, market news and market context (indices, volatility, USD exchange rates).
- Chile first: values in CLP using the "dólar observado" exchange rate.

## Data sources and freshness

Stock and ETF prices come from Yahoo Finance, crypto from CoinGecko and the Chilean "dólar observado" from mindicador.cl. These are free sources and can be delayed. Each price in the app shows its state ("Al día · hh:mm", "Retraso N min · hh:mm", "Mercado cerrado · hh:mm" or "Sin conexión · hh:mm"), computed from the timestamp the source reports.

## Free pages (no account)

- Investor profile quiz: https://invest.moyiq.app/perfil-inversor.html — 6 questions, about 2 minutes, conservative / moderate / aggressive. Indicative only.
- Market status: https://invest.moyiq.app/estado-mercado.html — US indices, VIX and USD → LATAM exchange rates, with the time of each query.
- FAQ: https://invest.moyiq.app/faq.html

## Data and accounts

The Invest portfolio is stored in the user's account (Supabase) to sync it. Login is shared with MOY IQ (same email and password); each app keeps its data separately. Deleting Invest data is self-service and immediate (Settings → Delete my Invest data); the shared login is kept and can be deleted through MOY IQ (support@moyiq.app).

## Disclaimer

Educational tool. It does not constitute financial or tax advice, nor a recommendation to buy or sell. Investing involves risk of loss. It is not a broker and does not execute orders.
